label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/ssrf): alert-TP — User-controlled 'host' parameter flows directly to URL construction at sink (new java.net.URL("http://" + host + "/api")). While isNonPublicAddress() check exists, it only blocks loopback/site-local/link-local/any-local addresses and does not validate the original hostname against SSRF patterns. Attacker-controlled input reaching the network endpoint constitutes SSRF vulnerability.

evidence.note: User param assigned to host, checked via resolveHost(), then fetched via fetchHttpByHostname(host)
fetchHttpByHostname constructs URL with host parameter and opens stream to external endpoint
